findings.evidence: diff to ZerothCohomology.lean:94 adds `-preprojectiveMk_eq_zero_iff`; the linter report shows the failure is `failed to synthesize Nontrivial (TauCeti.preprojectiveAlgebra k Q)` (typeclass timeout), not a normal-form problem.
findings.fix: Restore `@[simp]` and fix the actual timeout: provide or cache the `Nontrivial (preprojectiveAlgebra k Q)` / `Nontrivial (gaugedPreprojectiveAlgebra k ε)` instance search that times out. Otherwise drop `simp` from these lemmas; do not switch them to pre-lemmas.

findings.issue: The same `@[simp]`→`@[simp↓]` workaround appears across the PR. Pre-lemmas fire before arguments are normalized, and side conditions (`MemLp`, `AEMeasurable`, `Finite`) are then attempted at every node visited on the way down. Affected: FGComoduleCat.hom_smul, homotopyInclusion_map_quotient_map, stableCyclesFunctor_map_quotient_map, separableDegree_relativeFrobeniusIsogeny_map, stabilizerBallHomeomorph_smul, FDRep.op_smul_apply, derivation_algebraMap_laurentSeries, coe_nonnegDegreeDerivation, ComplexUCB.re_smul/im_smul, applyRight_compRightAlgHom_fst. Also these 13, which were neither reported violations nor in scripts/lint-baseline.txt: norm_sq_realModelMap, norm_formDualEquiv_ιMulti, norm_hodgeStar, norm_kahlerForm_sq, both ofMeasureLpMultiplication_mem_domain_iff, mem_lpTwoSubmodule, memLp_comp_mul_right_iff_of_regular, convolutionUCB_linftyOne, measure_inv_null_of_regular, atomMixture_singleton, map_dirac_of_aemeasurable, covariance_compoundPoissonMeasure, covarianceBilin_compoundPoissonMeasure, covariance_convolutionPower, QuaternionicProjectiveSpace.mk_eq_mk_iff.

summary: The PR swaps a large set of `@[simp]` lemmas to `@[simp↓]` to get past simpNF timeouts. That changes simp behaviour for every caller and already broke a downstream `simp` call. Dropping `@[simp]` from `smul_maximalIdeal_pow` also leaves simp stuck at `(σ • 𝔪) ^ n` with no lemma to finish.
